summary: DLMF 1.2 Elementary Algebra: In ( 1.2.1 ) and ( 1.2.3 ) k and n are nonnegative integers and k\leq n .
body: NIST DLMF section 1.2 (Elementary Algebra) says: "In ( 1.2.1 ) and ( 1.2.3 ) k and n are nonnegative integers and k\leq n . In ( 1.2.2 ), ( 1.2.4 ), and ( 1.2.5 ) n is a positive integer. See also § 26.3(i) . For complex z the binomial coefficient \genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{z}{k} is defined via ( 1.2.6 ). where \ell is n or n-1 according as n is even or odd. In ( 1.2.6 )–( 1.2.9 ) k and m are nonnegative integers and z is complex. where \ell = last term of the series = a+(n-1)d . Let \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\dots,\alpha_{n} be distinct constants, and f(x) be a polynomial of degree less than n . Then and f^{(k)} is the k -th derivative of f (§ 1.4(iii) ). If m_{1},m_{2},\dots,m_{n} are positive integers and \deg f<\sum_{j=1}^{n}m_{j} , then there exist polynomials f_{j}(x) , \deg f_{j}<m_{j} , such that To find the polynomials f_{j}(x) , j=1,2,\dots,n , multiply both sides by the denominator of the left-hand side and equate coefficients. See Chrystal ( 1959a , pp. 151–159) ." Equation 1.2.1 on the page has alt text "\genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{n}{k}=\frac{n!}{(n-k)!k!}=\genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{n}{n% -k}.". Equation 1.2.2 on the page has alt text "(a+b)^{n}=a^{n}+\genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{n}{1}a^{n-1}b+\genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{% n}{2}a^{n-2}b^{2}+\dots+\genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{n}{n-1}ab^{n-1}+b^{n}.". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
